settings.about: Desktop client for Stoat: themes and plugins.

builtinDescription.builtin:qol: Fixes and quality of life improvements.

interface.label: Interface Fixes
interface.hint: Fixes for small flaws in the user interface.

history.label: Reliable History Loading
history.hint: Retries message history requests that hang or are rejected by the server, and keeps the chat from jumping while older messages load.

media_player.label: Enhanced Media Player
media_player.hint: A feature-rich video/audio attachment player with a playback bar: the playing file keeps going when you switch chats.

emoji_picker.label: Enhanced Emoji Picker
emoji_picker.hint: Handy sections and other improvements for the emoji picker.

format_menu.label: Formatting Menu
format_menu.hint: Selecting text shows a handy popup for quick formatting, and the message box gets a context menu for inserting links, times and tables.

live_formatting.label: Live Formatting in Input
live_formatting.hint: Text in the input looks like the sent message, markup symbols show only near the cursor.

colored_text_font.label: Colored Text Font Fix
colored_text_font.hint: Colored text in messages uses the chat font instead of the formula font.

favorite_gifs.label: Favorite GIFs
favorite_gifs.hint: Save your favorite GIFs and get to them quickly.

gifs_open_favorites.label: Open the GIF Picker on Favorites

gif_previews.label: Favorite GIF previews
gif_previews.hint: From the internet nothing is kept on disk; stored locally they load faster.

hotkeys.label: Keybinds
hotkeys.hint: Control calls and the client window from the keyboard and mouse, even when minimized.

settings.hotkeysIntro: They work everywhere, even while the client is minimized or hidden in the tray. In the client window a keybind only does its action; other programs receive it as well. Call actions work like the buttons on the call card.
settings.hotkeysInactive: Keybinds start working when “Quality of Life” runs again — after the client reloads.
settings.hotkeyRecording: Press a key combination or a mouse button… Esc cancels
settings.permissionsIntro: The plugin will be able to send requests to these addresses on behalf of the client, bypassing the page's restrictions:
settings.permissionsHint: Other addresses stay closed to it. If a newer version of the plugin asks for more, the client will ask again.
settings.reloadNeeded: Plugin changes take effect after the client reloads.
settings.catalogIntro: Plugins from the Arachnid Client repository. A downloaded plugin is off — turn it on in the plugin list.
settings.catalogEmpty: There are no plugins in the catalog yet.
settings.removeIntro: The plugin will be removed together with its settings and data.
settings.installedOff: Installed — turn it on in the plugin list
settings.quickCssHint: Your own CSS on top of the client and the theme. Changes apply instantly and are saved to quickcss.css.
settings.noThemeSettings: This theme has no settings of its own.
settings.unsupported: This theme is written for the “{0}” preprocessor, which Arachnid Client does not support: the theme is applied as is and its settings are ignored.
settings.author: By {0}

packs.builtinHint: Built into the client: shows instantly, without loading from the server
packs.systemHint: Already in Windows (Segoe UI Emoji font): no download needed, flags come from the server
packs.installedHint: Downloaded ({0}): shows instantly, without loading from the server
packs.availableHint: Download ({0}): the pack will show instantly, without loading from the server

failure.missing: The pack is missing on the download server
failure.corrupt: The file arrived damaged, please try again
failure.unsupported: Downloading packs is only available on Windows

gifs.emptyBody: Add GIFs from the right-click menu — in chat and in Gifbox — or by link with the + button.
gifs.linkHint: To a GIF, a video, a Stoat attachment or a Tenor, Giphy, Imgur… page
gifs.descriptionHint: Search finds the GIF by the words of its description
gifs.noChannel: Open a channel to send a GIF
gifs.badMedia: the file does not open as an image or a video

errors.missing: this GIF is not in favorites

errors.notGifOrPage: the link is neither a GIF nor a page ({0})
errors.noMedia: the page has no GIF, video or image
